categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Scripts and tools' label and modifies contrib/seeds/makeseeds.py, which is explicitly covered as seed generation tooling.
categories.rationale: Prevents an unhandled IndexError in `makeseeds.py` when encountering a malformed or truncated crawler line with exactly 11 fields. While seed generation is an operator-facing tool, hitting exactly 11 fields on corrupt input is an edge case that is reasonably deferrable without broad disruption.
